accepted_groups.group: 2. Local GUI profile/preferences and shortcut transactions
accepted_groups.coverage: Import/reset/undo profile independence; seven accepted bindings; actual conflict replacement preserves ordinary F5/F6 holds; WM_CLOSE tray hide and actual MSAA Restore. Unaccepted Home Hide criterion excluded.

Same retained HWND Hide/actual MSAA Restore, native holds checked while hidden, Pause plain UP and Resume, six typed mode actions; actual menu Stop releases one plain pair per x64/x86 target, destroys overlays/descriptor, retains GUI F11; fresh target ToggleRouting Start and actual menu Quit releases F5, F11, lifecycle HWND and broker.

Session grant alone denies preference mutation; Apply access policy revokes old client; reconnect and observe registered client before Inspect plus two Configures, exactly three correlated current-client ACKs. Light-only merge retains zoom, full prefs restored; startup field forbidden before GUI ACK. Native events/cursor unchanged during preference writes.

accepted_groups.group: 5. Isolated startup registration and actual cold invocation
accepted_groups.coverage: Over-260 UTF16 command rejects before file/REG_EXPAND_SZ mutation; valid 218-unit exact command writes/removes REG_SZ only under own GUID key; exact stored command cold starts minimized with seven bindings, no routing, actual MSAA Restore/Quit and close-to-tray optout.

accepted_groups.group: 6. Truthful cleanup failure, recovery and standalone handoff
accepted_groups.coverage: One genuine PM_NOREMOVE fence timeout produces persistent error and disabled Start; ToggleRouting/profile replacement cannot bypass old-process quarantine; exact process exit clears it and fresh virtual F6 Stop delivers plain UP. Standalone Stop immediately followed by fresh-PID Start without retry/sleep/other RPC, then clean second Stop and F11 availability.

counting: Control counts are actual occurrences and include explicit setup/navigation; they are not summed as distinct feature tests. Original 163100 shortcut prefix has 12 accepted controls, retained rather than replayed. Quarantine21 is 19 clicks plus two truthful disabled observations.

failures_retained.interpretation: Original HWND discovery/UIA-environment/async sampler/path oracle and stale label/client assumptions remain recorded. Actual hidden-UI polling defect and overlong startup command boundary were fixed and independently passed current-image tails. No failed aggregate is relabeled PASS.

native_menu: Actual owned native popup/HMENU item verified by name, index, PID/thread and MSAA role, invoked through IAccessible.accDoDefaultAction. This is MSAA, not UIA or direct WM_COMMAND dispatch.

cleanup.note: One descriptor from forced-abort 193017 was removed by the runner only after exact owner identity and exited PID verification. This is not counted as product teardown success; normal Stop/Quit descriptor teardown was separately observed.

limits: GUI controller x64 and owned x64/x86 targets; standalone handoff uses x64 targets only. Each reattach uses fresh target processes.
No hardware/RustDesk input used for control or validation; no OS input injection, personal pixels or real Windows Run key. Actual login/logoff/reboot not exercised.

Queue-fence cleanup guarantee accepted for ordinary unfiltered GetMessage/PeekMessage PM_REMOVE only; selected-range PM_REMOVE remains excluded. One PM_NOREMOVE failure/quarantine case is not universal hung-provider compatibility.

No separate post-Restore/pre-Pause held-key poll; holds were checked while hidden and subsequent Pause delivered exact plain UP. Connected preferences writes were tested with no held keys at that point.
Partial successful registry-write rollback was not forced; long-command preflight preserves exact prior kind/bytes. Removing the final tray icon restoring a hidden GUI is source-reviewed only.

No desktop-wide or same-process multi-user isolation, full MouseMux Ultra parity, general app compatibility or full UX parity claim. Presentation approval remains separately bounded in docs/application-presentation-assessment-2026-10-14.json.
scope_control: Accepted prefixes reused after narrowly related source fixes; no historical feature suite replay. No further native cases required for this bounded gate.
